Subject: Sandbox validation proposal: Redwood + ScaleCraft interop testing

Hi Evelyn / Sergio,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the initial interop sandbox. Attached is our proposed test plan (ScaleCraft-Redwood-TestPlan-v1.pdf) — it covers model variants (fp16 / int8 / int4 where applicable), KV cache behavior, batching profiles, and a canonical workload based on a customer POC.

Our team will provide a containerized adapter and a small harness that emits simulated traffic (docs + harness are in the Drive link below). For the kickoff we want to validate three things:
- Functional compatibility: can our adapter talk to Redwood runtime without custom patches?
- Performance envelope: latency p50/p95 and tokens/sec for 1–8 concurrent streams
- Quantization/accuracy: ensure int8/int4 variants do not regress critical prompts by >3% per your eval metric

Can we schedule a 30–45m engineer-to-engineer session tomorrow to confirm test IPs, IAM, and where to drop artifacts? Also we plan to run an initial 24h smoke workload and will upload a results CSV and logs when finished.

Subject: Sandbox run results (initial): Redwood + ScaleCraft interop

Evelyn / Sergio — thanks for running the harness. We completed a 24h smoke run and uploaded the CSV + logs. High-level summary below; full CSV attached (sandbox-results-20260114.csv).

What passed:
- Adapter handshake and model selection: OK across fp16 and int8 variants.
- Basic streaming: chunked responses and tool-calling hooks worked end-to-end.
- Batching profiles: we hit expected tokens/sec for 1–4 concurrent streams (within 8% of our lab baseline).

Observed issues:
- KV cache mismatch: when using int4-packed models our adapter observed stale KV cache entries after a model switch. Suspect a serialization index mismatch in the cache header. This only appeared when quantized int4 variant was forced on A100 nodes.
- Latency variance: p95 latency for long-context (8k+) sequences spiked with batched requests — looks like a kernel scheduling interaction under our specific batch shapes.

Artifacts: sandbox-results-20260114.csv (attached), logs in Drive, debug traces in S3 (link in Drive).

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood engineering to reproduce KV cache issue with quantized int4 build (we can provide the exact model artifact).
2) Joint triage call to review token traces and narrow down kernel scheduling vs batch-formation bugs.
3) If reproducible, propose a short compatibility shim on the adapter while a runtime fix is developed.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp

Thanks,
Alex Ran
Solutions Architect, ScaleCraft
